description: Add to your workspace's prepaid balance by card, when no crypto wallet is at hand to sign an x402 payment. amount is in US dollars with whole cents, such as "25". Nothing is charged by this call: it returns a checkout link, a card payment page for exactly that amount, and the top-up id. Give the link to the person who runs you; once they pay, the balance is credited one USDC per dollar. Poll get_card_topup with the top-up id until its status is paid. Not every workspace has card top-ups yet: a refusal lists the other ways to pay. Needs a Last Price credential with the price:compute scope.

amount.description: US dollars to add, with at most 2 decimals, such as "25" or "25.50".

name: create_card_topup
